items.title: Govt expects to finalise IMF talks by January

items.title: Asia takes 70% of trained workers sent abroad
items.description: Bangladesh is expanding skills programmes to prepare workers for overseas jobs, and 70 percent of trained workers placed abroad have gone to Asian markets.

items.title: BB eases import credit terms for Ramadan essentials
items.description: To help stabilise prices and ensure an adequate supply of essential commodities during Ramadan, Bangladesh Bank (BB) has allowed commercial imports of 10 essential food items under relaxed payment terms.

items.title: StanChart sees ‘considerable interest’ in sale of retail business
items.description: Standard Chartered Bangladesh has said it is in talks with some banks regarding the sale of its wealth and retail banking business in the country and sees “considerable interest” among potential buyers.

items.title: Dollar rises against taka as fuel import payments mount
items.description: The US dollar continues to appreciate against the local currency taka as banks face higher foreign currency payment obligations for fuel and essential commodity imports ahead of Ramadan.

items.title: RMG exports to EU up by nearly 3% in Jul-Oct
items.description: Bangladesh’s readymade garment (RMG) exports to the European Union rose 2.79 percent year-on-year to $6.43 billion in the July-October period of fiscal year 2026-27.

items.title: War to cost Gulf over $200b in damage, $790b losses until 2030: insurer
items.description: The US-Iran war will cost Gulf countries more than $200 billion in damage and economic losses could reach nearly four times that amount by 2030, insurer Allianz Trade said on Wednesday.
